They can be found in most large cities and towns, especially those in [[Misthalin]], such as [[Lumbridge]], [[Falador]], and [[Varrock]]. While less common, they can also be found in remote areas such as the [[Wilderness]]. Men can be pickpocketed by [[members]] at level 1 [[Thieving]], yielding 8 experience points and 3 [[coins]]. They often drop low-level [[herb|herbs]] when killed on members-only servers. Talking to [[men]] gives a 1/128 chance of being offered a [[flyer]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/987284477973065728|date=20 April
